tools.name: Loan EMI
tools.readerQuestion: What is my monthly loan payment?
tools.publishedSpecification: Fixed-rate amortisation, plus a separate zero-interest branch.
tools.formula: EMI = P x r x (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1), r = annual rate / 1200
tools.roundingRule: full precision inside the calculation; round once at display; two decimals for rupees, one for percentages
tools.invalidInputRule: negative or absurd values return a plain explanation, never a number
tools.verification: test_growth_tool_math.py (growth_tool_math.01 arithmetic cross-checked by loop and inverse calls)
tools.requiredDisclosure: An illustration from stated inputs, not advice. Rates, taxes and charges must be confirmed with the lender, fund or tax rules in force.
